test: Test 3: can on-board group descriptors find the same group in another robot's map?
written: 2026-10-19, before test3.py was written or run
data: Saved maps of all four robots, all 337 steps of the frozen B0 release run (data/tcaff_baseline_release); evaluation uses objects.txt and GT poses only

groups.oracle: map objects within 0.5 m XY of an objects.txt box and 0.08 <= z_world < 0.9 m, grouped by the GT group of that box (single-linkage 0.7 m of objects.txt); groups with >= 2 members
groups.onboard: test-1 rules without wall lines: w <= 0.5, 0.08 <= h <= 0.6, |z - z_robot| <= 0.35; single linkage 0.7 m; 2..10 members, radius <= 1.0 m; identity = dominant GT group if it holds >= 50% of members, otherwise a false group

descriptors.size: symmetric Chamfer distance between member sets in (log w, log h)
descriptors.arrangement: symmetric Chamfer distance between the sets of pairwise XY distances of members
descriptors.radius: |r_A - r_B|, r = max member distance to the group centre
descriptors.combined: s = -mean of the four distances, each divided by its median over all candidate group pairs (label-free normalisation, equal weights, no tuning)

metrics.top1: share of (directed pair, step, group of map a whose GT group is present in map b) where the true group ranks first among map-b groups
metrics.chance_top1: mean of 1 / number of map-b candidates over the same cases
metrics.top2_recall: share where the true group is among the two best
metrics.top2_wrong_pruned: share of wrong group pairs not in the two best of their map-a group
metrics.auc: same-group vs different-group similarity over all candidate pairs
metrics.units: steps are strongly dependent; the number of unique (robot pair, GT group) cases is reported

decision_rule: On oracle groups with the combined descriptor: top1 >= 0.80 and top2_recall >= 0.95 -> proceed to an on-board group gate; top1 >= chance_top1 + 0.20 but below the first rule -> size and arrangement are not enough, add colour; otherwise -> descriptors without colour fail. On-board results are reported but do not change this verdict.
status: exploratory; one recording; group construction thresholds were chosen with knowledge of the box layout (tests 1-2)
